evidence.quote: The model takes single-cell RNA-seq profiles as input

decisions.rationale: R0: the element names the input data object without a transformation.

evidence.quote: We chose Geneformer (Theodoris et al., 2023b; Chen et al., 2024), a transformer-based model pre-trained specifically on single-cell genomics data on masked gene prediction task, as our cell encoder

decisions.rationale: R3: Geneformer encoder is a named learned encoder module.

evidence.quote: We propose a gene-level embedding strategy
For a given cell, Geneformer produces a sequence of N gene embeddings

decisions.rationale: R0: the element names the resulting embedding representation without naming a computation.

evidence.quote: We introduce a lightweight adapter module to bridge the dimensional and semantic gaps between the Geneformer's output and the LLM's input embedding space.
This module consists of a two-layer feedforward network with non-linear activation that projects each gene embedding to the natural language semantic space.
The adapter module remains trainable in both training strategies

decisions.rationale: R3: adapter module maps embeddings into the language-model space, so it is represented as a learned projection.

parameters.name: template
parameters.value: System: You are a scientific assistant specialized in cell description predictions. Given the cell sentence embeddings, describe it clearly and concisely in professional language. User: Sequence embeddings: H g, 1 | H g, 2 | ... | H g,N Assistant: < CELL DESCRIPTION >

parameters.name: order
parameters.value: system message -> user sequence embeddings -> assistant response placeholder

evidence.quote: To guide the LLM's generative process and ensure consistent output format, we adopted a specific instruction-following prompt structure that integrates a system message and the contextualized gene embeddings:

System : You are a scientific assistant specialized in cell description predictions. Given the cell sentence embeddings, describe it clearly and concisely in professional language. User : Sequence embeddings: H g, 1 | H g, 2 | ... | H g,N Assistant : < CELL DESCRIPTION >

decisions.rationale: R6: an instruction-following prompt structure serializes the system instruction, sequence embeddings, and output format.

evidence.quote: We performed full fine-tuning on both Meta-Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Gemma3-4B-it models, updating all parameters to adapt the pre-trained LLMs to our domain-specific cell description task.
A pretrained, instruction-tuned LLM decoder then generates structured natural language descriptions

decisions.rationale: R3: the decoder is the receiving pretrained language model and remains a learned-module boundary.

decisions.chain_element: Meta-Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct decoder with LoRA on self-attention modules

evidence.quote: LoRA selectively injects trainable low-rank matrices into the transformer architecture's attention mechanism
For the LoRA adapter, we apply it exclusively to the self-attention modules in the LLaMA decoder

decisions.rationale: R3: the element names a pretrained decoder with an adaptation mechanism, so it remains a learned-module boundary.
